newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain seen buying pesetas at 84.88 vs mark.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain seen buying pesetas at 84.88 vs mark.

text.p: The Bank of Spain was buying pesetas at around 84.80/85 per mark, local dealers said on Wednesday.
No-one at the central bank was immediately available, although its usual policy is to decline to comment.
"The Bank of Spain is in there at around 84.80/85 (per mark)" said a local forex dealer.
The peseta was affected by weakness in the French market following rumours of a poll pointing to a Socialist win in Sunday's runoff parliamentary elections, dealers said.
Spanish bonds and stocks were also sharply lower for the same reason this afternoon.
